item.title: That free 2-hour Google course was spliced together: harness, eval, loop and graph
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. Through October and November the same video was reposted in four or five languages. The copy said Google had released a free two hour harness engineering course that takes you from zero to a 24/7 self-evolving agent system. The video exists. The content is real. Free is real. The word course is not.
